name: closed_class_pos
doc:
CLOSED-CLASS PART OF SPEECH - comprehensive linguistics, step 4 (Matt, 2026-10-10; syntax
kept closed-class only by choice). The function words tag deterministically; open-class
declines. Sealed through linguistics.LING_VERIFY. Idempotent.

sticks.question: Closed-class part of speech - the function words

marks.claim: [a closed class, SEALED] 'the' is an article (sealed through linguistics.LING_VERIFY). The function words - articles, prepositions, pronouns, conjunctions, auxiliaries, determiners - are a finite, enumerable set, so their part of speech is deterministic.

[open class declines - the offline floor] A noun/verb/adjective/adverb depends on usage and morphology; the engine DECLINES open-class POS rather than guess. Syntax is kept closed-class only by choice; deep parsing is the declined floor. 0 false positives: a POS is confirmed only by membership in the curated closed-class set.
[on the one map - comprehensive linguistics, step 4] Closed-class POS joins the linguistics floor (card_floor_indo_european) with phonology, morphology, etymology, transliteration and semantics.
